A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''mercenary''' was a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. He fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, his group of mercenaries was attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

The mercenary and his [[Unidentified female mercenary (Ruusan)|female companion]] were the only survivors of the attack; five other mercenaries having been slaughtered by Bane. The two mercenaries were later taken prisoner by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who did not believe their words regarding the survival of the Sith, taking into account the two's unflattering reputation.
